questions.question_text: 9.圓O的內接四邊形ABCD中，$\overline{AB} = 4$，$\overline{BC} = 3$，$\overline{CD} = 3$，∠ABC = 60°，則 (1)$\overline{AD} = 1$ (2)$\overline{AD} = 4$ (3)$\overline{AC} = 13$ (4)四邊形ABCD的面積為$\frac{15}{4}$ (5)圓O的面積為$\frac{13}{3}\pi$。
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】∵ ∠ABC = 60°
∴ ∠ADC = 120° △ABC中，${\overline{AC}}^{2} = 4^{2} + 3^{2} - 2 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot \cos 60° = 13$ ⇒ $\overline{AC} = \sqrt{13}$ △ACD中，令$\overline{AD} = a$ ${\overline{AC}}^{2} = {\overline{AD}}^{2} + {\overline{CD}}^{2} - 2\overline{AD} \cdot \overline{CD} \cdot \cos 120°$
⇒ $13 = a^{2} + 9 - 2 \cdot a \cdot 3 \cdot ( - \frac{1}{2})$ ⇒ a^2 + 3a − 4 = 0 ⇒ (a + 4)(a − 1) = 0 ⇒ a = 1 即$\overline{AD} = 1$

(4)四邊形ABCD面積$= \bigtriangleup ABC + \bigtriangleup ACD = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot \sin 60° + \frac{1}{2} \cdot 1 \cdot 3 \cdot \sin 120°$ $= 3\sqrt{3} + \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{15\sqrt{3}}{4}$。
(5)$2R = \frac{\overline{AC}}{\sin 60°} = \frac{\sqrt{13}}{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}$ ⇒ $R = \frac{\sqrt{13}}{\sqrt{3}}$
∴ 圓O面積$= \pi R^{2} = \frac{13}{3}\pi$ 故選(1)(5)。
